newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RESEARCH ALERT - Village Roadshow buy.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RESEARCH ALERT - Village Roadshow buy.

text.p: Morgan Stockbroking Ltd recommended Village Roadshow Ltd as a buy, saying the company provides a solid exposure to the growth industries of entertainment, tourism and leisure.

"Recommendation is buy. Fundamentals highlight expectation of strong future profit growth. Management has consistently delivered record profits each year," Morgan analyst Sophie Mitchell said in a report.
Mitchell forecast further growth in the current year ending June 30, 1997, with net profit of A$57.1 million compared with $47.5 million in 1995/96.

Village's investment in theme parks and radio continued to perform well with solid operating profit growth expected for the Gold Coast, Queensland theme parks and the Triple M and Today radio networks, Mitchell said.
Aggressive expansion plans would be funded from the group's strong balance sheet and growing operating cash flow.

The company had cash balances at June 30 this year of almost A$270 million and a U.S. debt raising was expected this year, Mitchell said. "The net tangible asset backing of A$2.84 a share seriously understates the value of Village's assets."
